descriptions.mira: A determined traveler seeking the truth about the Cartographer's death.
descriptions.corvin: The gate warden of Greyharn who keeps secrets and has a hidden agenda.
descriptions.hessa: An old woman who runs a shop dealing in outdated maps and helps Mira in her quest.
descriptions.vell: The harbor official who orchestrated the flood to protect a smuggling ledger.
descriptions.tomas_reyne: A young clerk at the customs house who has been forging harbor records for years.
descriptions.tomas_hale: The keeper's son at the lighthouse who saw lantern lights moving inside the sealed Cistern.
